title: Finitely Verifiable Segmentation: Decidability for Every Tokenizer with a Finite-State Verifier
abstract: arXiv:2610.30168v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A segmentation policy assigns to each byte string at most one segmentation into tokens. Call it finitely verifiable when a finite automaton over marked strings, bytes paired with boundary bits, accepts exactly the policy's own segmentations. The automaton judges a proposed segmentation and need not compute one. The paper shows what that hypothesis buys. Four questions that practice settles by folklore become decidable, whether a window certifies a token boundary, whether the boundary gap is bounded, whether a mask keeps generation completable, and whether two policies are equivalent. The last three specialize limitedness, coaccessibility and the equivalence of single-valued transducers. The first refines the synchronizing cut of code theory, and two more ask whether a certified cut, or the cuts of an inventory, let each piece scan alone. translated_title: 有限可验证的分段：配备有限状态验证器的每个分词器均可判定
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.30168v1 公告类型：cross 摘要：分段策略为每个字节串指定至多一种切分为词元的分段方式。当定义在带标记字符串（即字节与边界位成对）上的有限自动机恰好接受该策略自身的分段时，我们称该策略是有限可验证的。该自动机用于评判一个给定的分段方案，而无需自行计算分段。本文展示了这一假设所带来的收益。四个原本在实践中靠经验规则解决的问题由此变为可判定的：一个窗口是否能证明某个词元边界、边界间隙是否有界、一个掩码是否能保持生成可补全，以及两个策略是否等价。后三个问题分别特化了单值转换器的有限性、余可达性与等价性问题；第一个问题精化了码理论中的同步切割概念，另外两个问题则询问一个经验证的切割、或某个清单中的所有切割，是否允许每个片段独立扫描。该类策略严格介于在线可扫描策略与具有正则定义域的策略之间，并且……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出“有限可验证分段”这一概念——即分段策略的结果恰好可被一个有限自动机验证——并证明在此假设下四个实际分词问题（边界窗口证明、边界间隙有界性、掩码生成可补全性以及策略等价性）均变为可判定问题。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces "finitely verifiable segmentation," where a finite automaton accepts exactly a policy's own segmentations, and proves that under this hypothesis four practical tokenization questions—boundary certification by a window, bounded boundary gap, mask-preserving generation completability, and policy equivalence—become decidable.
